_note: Comment auto-reply rules for this brand. Copy to rules.json, edit, then upload with: npx wrangler kv key put rules --path rules.json --binding KV --remote. A rule sends only when tested is true (you tried the keyword from a second account) and MODE is live. The public reply never has a link; the link goes in the dm. disclosure is added to the end of every automatic DM. A rule with require_follow: true sends the link only to people who follow the account: the first private message (ask) has a button, the person taps or replies, the publisher reads whether they follow, then sends dm (the link) or a short reminder (follow_nudge, up to max_nudges times). ask and follow_nudge may not contain a link. Optional cards: add "cards": true with "link_url" (an https address) and, with require_follow, "follow_url" (the https address of the account's profile). The ask and the reminder then carry real buttons ("follow_label" opens the profile, follow_button is a tap button) and the link message carries one link button ("link_button"). If Meta refuses a card the publisher falls back to a quick-reply chip, then to plain text with the link in it.

rules.name: kit-follow
rules.ask: Thanks for commenting! Tap the button and I will send the kit.
rules.follow_nudge: I can't see that you follow us yet. Follow the account, then tap the button again.
